replacements.Cache, model routing, fallback y worker: Caching, model routing, fallback, and worker placement are not the same layer
Hard constraints come first. A cache hit can avoid inference; a miss activates the model policy. Only then is a worker selected. Fallback happens after a failure and needs its own budget and compatibility contract.

replacements.La petición atraviesa restricciones dura: The request passes through hard constraints and a response cache. An admitted hit returns a cached result; a miss enters a policy that selects a model. The selected model is sent to a worker according to load and KV locality. A failure opens a fallback branch only when the error, budget, and compatibility allow it. Telemetry and paired evaluations feed later policy updates.

replacements.<strong>Lectura:</strong> el sistema fil: Reading: the system first filters what it cannot execute correctly. The cache can close the request without inference. On a miss, the router selects a model and another layer then selects a worker. A failure does not automatically enable fallback: budget must remain, the alternative must be compatible, and partial output or external effects must not break semantics. The policy improves from evidence about decisions and alternatives, not only from the cases it selected.
